item.title: Version 1.2.0
item.description:
Perch can now transform what you are holding.

  • transform files without leaving the shelf
    Convert images between JPEG, PNG, HEIC, and TIFF, resize them, or remove metadata. Perch keeps the source by default, and you can choose Replace in Settings.
  • merge documents in the right order
    Select PDFs and images, arrange them as document tiles, then merge them into one PDF.
  • select and rearrange like Finder
    Command and Shift selection now follow Finder, and selected items move together when you reorder them.
  • five recent download sessions
    Perch now offers the five most recent download sessions instead of three.
